item.title: Calverton runway licensed for U.S. Open parking, shuttle buses: Jan. 21 Town Board meeting wrap
item.description: A rundown of actions taken at the Jan. 21 Riverhead Town Board meeting: EPCAL runway license agreement for U.S. Open parking, amendment to the town square lease agreement with master developer, more.

item.title: Edward Norman Bracht, 85
item.description: Edward Norman Bracht of Riverhead died Jan. 16, 2026. He was 85 years old.

item.title: Two ‘ICE OUT’ events planned in Riverhead this weekend
item.description: A candlelight vigil Friday at Town Hall and a Route 58 protest Saturday outside Staples Plaza will highlight calls for ICE accountability.

item.title: Peconic Ice Rink dome partially deflates under weight of snow and ice following weekend storm
item.description: The ice rink dome has been reinflated but the rink is temporarily closed while the operator works to remove remaining ice and snow from the dome and its perimeter.

item.title: LaLota announces $2.25M for Calverton water main extension to serve area affected by former Grumman site pollution
item.description: The Riverhead Water District extension will serve 28 homes southeast of the former Navy-owned site, affected or threatened by a plume of groundwater contamination.

item.title: Dorothy J. Behr, 93
item.description: Dorothy Jean “Dottie” Behr, longtime Cutchogue resident, died at home on January 24, 2026. She was 93 years old. Dottie was born on March 14, 1932 in Westhampton Beach to Anna (Sedaraveh) and Sigmund Milouski, and graduated from Westhampton Beach High School with the Class of 1950. item.title: Portion of Pulaski Street closed for snow removal Thursday morning
item.description: Pulaski Street between Osborn and Marcy avenues is closed this morning for snow removal, Riverhead Highway Superintendent Mike Zaleski said this morning.

item.title: Bubble domed ice rink at Calverton park remains closed, awaiting permission to reopen
item.description: The Peconic Hockey Foundation rink director said Wednesday afternoon he hopes to have the town's permission to reopen the rink on Thursday.
